milestones.title: Beta
milestones.notes: Dates are from Blizzard's 2026/2027 roadmap image in the What's Next recap ("BETA SEPT 17 - OCT 22", "PLAY UP TO LEVEL 30"). The recap text also says beta begins September 17. No times given.

milestones.title: Early name reservation
contents: Early name reservation and character creation
milestones.notes: Date from the roadmap image ("OCT 27 EARLY NAME RESERVATION & CHARACTER CREATION"). warcraft.wiki.gg gives 20:00 UTC; not checked against Blizzard, so kept date-only.

milestones.title: Launch
contents: Normal, PvP, Roleplay and Roleplay-PvP rulesets
milestones.notes: Blizzard: "launches globally on November 4, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. PST" = 23:00 UTC. The Now Live post is dated 2026-11-04T23:00:00Z. Rulesets at launch per the 2026-11-03 What's New post (Hardcore to follow).

milestones.title: Raids unlock
contents: Onyxia's Lair: 40 players; every raider needs the Drakefire Amulet to enter
milestones.notes: Blizzard repeats "December 9" in the roadmap image, the What's Next recap, the Raid Overview (2026-10-20) and the Now Live post (2026-11-04). No unlock time has been published, so the date is kept date-only. Raids reset weekly per the Raid Overview; reset day/time not stated. Secondary sources (Icy Veins, Warcraft Tavern, Method) agree on Dec 9 and also give no time.

milestones.title: Hardcore launch
contents: Hardcore ruleset: a separate ecosystem where death is permanent; dead characters can transfer to another ruleset
milestones.notes: No date. The roadmap image places "FOREVER HARDCORE LAUNCH" in the WINTER column, after the Dec 9 raid unlock. The Now Live post (2026-11-04) says Hardcore "will become available sometime after launch"; the Oct 29 post says "Additional details and timing will be shared later." The window bounds (Dec 1 to Feb 28) are our reading of Northern Hemisphere meteorological winter; the roadmap puts Dec 9 in winter, which fits. Some secondary sites write "Winter 2026"; Blizzard's image only says Winter. Bounds are an estimate, used only for ordering and re-check timing.

milestones.title: Spring major update
contents: New quests and a new playable area
milestones.notes: From the roadmap image ("MAJOR UPDATES" under SPRING). The image header reads "2026 | 2027 ROADMAP", so spring is spring 2027. Footer: "Content and timing subject to change." Blizzard does not call this a phase. No PvP season numbers or dates have been published.

milestones.title: Summer major update
milestones.notes: From the roadmap image ("MAJOR UPDATES" under SUMMER). Which raid is revamped has not been announced.
